criteria.why: State is independent, but each row is a min-size horizontal Flex whose label is only loosely flexible, so the row shrink-wraps and the toggle sits 12px after the label text instead of at the right end (toggles do not line up between rows).

Slider drags and taps correctly over 12..24 with a rounded value, but the label line shrink-wraps (loose grow, cross-axis start), so the number sits right after 'Text size' at the left, not at the right end of the line.

1-settings-1.tsx.notes: Relies on grow={1} to fill rows: the Notifications card hugs its widest row while the Display card is stretched by the justify:center slider row, and the dividers (height only, loose width) collapse to zero width.
